unit.why: A single narrative: R. Berish travels to his master's grave in Kshanov on Lag ba-Omer, sees him in a spiritual body, and at the hilula meal sees him seated at the table.

stories.start_quote: בשנת תקפ״ט נסע הה״ק ר״ב עם אנשי בריתו
stories.summary_en: In 1829 R. Berish goes with his followers to his master's grave in Kshanov on Lag ba-Omer, the yahrzeit. He recites psalms, lays kvitlekh on the grave and sees his master in a white spiritual body. At the festive meal he refuses to end with grace, because he sees his master sitting at the table with him.

tags.why: the visit to the master's grave on the yahrzeit frames the story
